_meta.use: Single source for brand, contact and people on About/Contact/author box and Organization/Person schema (seo-rules.md 6-7).

reviewer.note: Technical reviewer must be a real PEC-registered electrical engineer before launch (engineer-reviewer.md). Fill name, credential (e.g. 'BSc Electrical Engineering, PEC-registered engineer'), pec_registration, same_as (LinkedIn/PEC profile) and signed_off date, then set status to signed_off. Until then no reviewer name is shown anywhere.

analytics.note: Installed through Google Site Kit (build-plan Phase 0). Set enabled false if analytics is removed; the privacy policy text follows this flag.

ads.note: Stays false until AdSense approves the site (seo-rules.md 8). When approved: set adsense_pub_id (pub-...) so /ads.txt is served, then enabled true.

consent.note: Name of the Google-certified CMP once installed (seo-rules.md 8); shown in the privacy policy.

organization_same_as_note: Add brand profile URLs (YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn page) to organization_same_as as each one goes live; they appear in Organization schema sameAs.
